AWS Compute Services

AWS 计算服务

You love programming and spend your free time designing and creating new software applications on your personal computer. You recently created an application that converts input images to cartoon images and demoed this to your friend, who happens to be a software engineer at a big tech company. The friend really liked the idea and suggested sharing the application with other people—plus it can help you earn some extra dollars. But how can you achieve this task? How can you make a program running on a personal computer accessible to other people?

你热爱编程，把空闲时间都花在个人电脑上设计和创建新软件应用。你最近做了一个把输入图片转换成卡通图片的应用，并演示给一位朋友——他恰好在一家大型科技公司做软件工程师。朋友很喜欢这个点子，建议你把应用分享给其他人——而且这还能帮你赚点外快。但你怎么实现这件事？怎么让运行在个人电脑上的程序能被其他人访问？

For this specific example, you need some mechanism that allows people to send an image to a personal computer and the personal computer to return the output as a cartoon image via the internet. In this scenario, the personal computer is acting as a server. A server is nothing but a computer that is running most of the time (i.e., a highly available application), responsible for serving any kind of request. This server can be accessible just to you, to any other computer, or to other users, who all are referred to as clients.

在这个具体例子中，你需要某种机制，让人们能把图片发送到一台个人电脑、再由这台个人电脑通过互联网把卡通图片结果返回。在这个场景中，这台个人电脑扮演服务器的角色。服务器不过是一台大部分时间都在运行的计算机（即一个高可用应用），负责服务各类请求。这台服务器可以只让你自己访问、让任何其他计算机访问、或让其他用户访问——这些都称为客户端。

Servers are an essential part of any application, and AWS offers multiple compute platforms to run applications. A compute platform in the AWS cloud is a virtual server hosted in an AWS data center that can be accessed over the internet. We’ll start our discussion with a compute platform similar to a personal computer called Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), and then we’ll move on to AWS Lambda and containerization services present in the AWS cloud.

服务器是任何应用不可或缺的一部分，而 AWS 提供多种计算平台来运行应用。AWS 云中的计算平台是托管在 AWS 数据中心、可通过互联网访问的虚拟服务器。我们先从一个类似个人电脑的计算平台讲起——Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud（EC2），然后再谈 AWS Lambda 和 AWS 云中的容器化服务。

Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud

Amazon EC2 is a scalable virtual server hosting services provided by AWS. We can leverage the EC2 service to create VMs in the AWS cloud with a required set of configurations, such as CPU, memory, storage, networking, and so on. These VMs or virtual computing environments are called instances.

Amazon EC2 是 AWS 提供的可扩展虚拟服务器托管服务。我们可以利用 EC2 服务在 AWS 云中创建具有所需配置集的虚拟机，例如 CPU、内存、存储、网络等。这些虚拟机或虚拟计算环境称为实例（instance）。

Page 301

AWS provides the option to select bare-metal servers or to go with a virtualized environment maintained via hypervisor, which should be determined by identifying your business and compliance requirements. Here are general descriptions of bare-metal and hypervisor servers:

AWS 提供选择裸金属服务器、或采用通过 hypervisor 维护的虚拟化环境的选项，这应根据你的业务和合规要求来决定。下面是裸金属服务器和 hypervisor 服务器的一般描述：

  • Bare-metal server. Physical servers dedicated to a single tenant. These servers are helpful for workloads that require direct access to Intel Xeon processor infrastructure, such as Intel virtualization (VT-x), that have a strict compliance requirement, or that need to run a custom hypervisor. For example, you might need to run Oracle Hypervisor instead of Nitro.
    裸金属服务器。专属于单一租户的物理服务器。这类服务器适合需要直接访问 Intel Xeon 处理器基础设施（如 Intel 虚拟化 VT-x）、有严格合规要求、或需要运行自定义 hypervisor 的负载。例如，你可能需要运行 Oracle Hypervisor 而不是 Nitro。
  • Hypervisor. A virtualization component for running multiple VMs on a single physical server, as shown in Figure 11-1. Hypervisor helps allocate computing resources, such as CPU and memory, to VMs running their own OS and applications. AWS supports two hypervisors based on available instance types: Xen and Nitro. The Nitro system is a new-generation hypervisor with enhanced security and performance.
    Hypervisor。一种虚拟化组件，用于在单台物理服务器上运行多个虚拟机，如图 11-1 所示。Hypervisor 帮助把 CPU、内存等计算资源分配给运行各自操作系统和应用的虚拟机。AWS 根据可用实例类型支持两种 hypervisor：Xen 和 Nitro。Nitro 系统是新一代 hypervisor，具有增强的安全性和性能。

Launching and running instances in the AWS cloud is easy and removes the headache of maintaining physical hardware. EC2 instances can be launched with just a few clicks on the AWS Console by following the steps in the AWS documentation. The instances are launched with a specific set of configurations that are determined by Amazon Machine Image (AMI).

在 AWS 云中启动和运行实例很简单，免去了维护物理硬件的麻烦。按照 AWS 文档中的步骤，在 AWS 控制台上点几下就能启动 EC2 实例。实例以一组特定配置启动，这些配置由 Amazon 机器镜像（AMI）决定。

One EC2 instance doesn’t necessarily map to one physical server in the AWS cloud.
在 AWS 云中，一个 EC2 实例并不必然对应一台物理服务器。
Page 302

Amazon Machine Image

We can launch an EC2 instance with different configurations, such as the OS, the storage volumes attached to the instance, the install dependencies before instance bootup, custom security configurations, and so on. These configurations can be defined via a preconfigured template called an AMI, which enables easy, efficient provisioning of EC2 instances with the desired software stack. Consider a scenario where you as an engineer are responsible for installing security dependencies to all the EC2 instances launched in an organization. One way is to run scripts on these EC2 instances after they are launched, but a more optimal way would be to create a base AMI with all the required dependencies installed. This saves a lot of time and ensures 100% confidence that none of the EC2 instances are missed for the required dependencies.

我们可以用不同配置启动 EC2 实例，例如操作系统、挂载到实例的存储卷、实例启动前要安装的依赖、自定义安全配置等。这些配置可以通过一个叫 AMI 的预配置模板来定义，它能轻松、高效地开通带有期望软件栈的 EC2 实例。想象这样一个场景：你作为工程师，负责给组织中启动的所有 EC2 实例安装安全依赖。一种方式是在这些 EC2 实例启动后再在上面跑脚本，但更优的方式是创建一个已安装所有所需依赖的基础 AMI。这能节省大量时间，并 100% 确保没有任何一个 EC2 实例漏掉所需依赖。

As customers, we can launch EC2 instances using freely available AMIs from the AWS community, purchase AMIs from third parties such as Red Hat, or create our own custom AMIs depending on our needs. For example, Amazon Linux and Linux 2 AMIs are available free of cost and are fully supported and maintained by AWS. AWS provides a marketplace where users can choose from a wide variety of publicly available AMIs. Here are few considerations for choosing the best AMI for your business use case:

作为客户，我们可以使用 AWS 社区免费提供的 AMI 启动 EC2 实例，从 Red Hat 等第三方购买 AMI，或根据需要创建自己的自定义 AMI。例如，Amazon Linux 和 Linux 2 AMI 免费提供，并由 AWS 完全支持和维护。AWS 提供一个市场，用户可以从种类繁多的公开 AMI 中选择。下面是为业务用例选择最佳 AMI 时的几点考虑：

  • Region. AMIs are created specific to the region. If an AMI is not available in a specific region, you can copy the AMI to the required region and use it to launch EC2 instances.
    区域。AMI 是按区域创建的。如果某个 AMI 在特定区域不可用，你可以把它复制到所需区域，再用它启动 EC2 实例。
  • OS and architecture. EC2 instance runs on an OS, and you can choose from multiple OS flavors (32-bit or 64-bit architectures) supported by AWS.
    操作系统与架构。EC2 实例运行在某个操作系统上，你可以从 AWS 支持的多种操作系统（32 位或 64 位架构）中选择。
  • Launch permissions. An AMI can be owned by AWS, businesses, or individuals, and it can be made available to the general public, a set of users, or just a single individual.
    启动权限。AMI 可以由 AWS、企业或个人拥有，并可以向公众、一组用户或仅单个个人开放。
  • Root device storage. AMIs are backed either by Amazon EBS or by an instance store (see Chapter 10 for more details) as root device storage. The root device storage contains the image used to boot the EC2 instance. There are significant differences between these storage choices, such as size limit (64 TB for EBS io2 Block Express and 10 GB for instance store), data persistence, and boot time (usually less than one minute for EBS and less than five minutes for instance store).
    根设备存储。AMI 的根设备存储要么由 Amazon EBS 支撑，要么由实例存储支撑（详见第 10 章）。根设备存储包含用于启动 EC2 实例的镜像。这两种存储选择之间有显著差异，例如大小限制（EBS io2 Block Express 为 64 TB，实例存储为 10 GB）、数据持久性和启动时间（EBS 通常不到一分钟，实例存储不到五分钟）。
Page 303
You can find the complete details on EC2 instance root device storage in the AWS documentation.
EC2 实例根设备存储的完整细节请见 AWS 文档。

The next decision we need to make is the instance type. AWS offers a wide range of instance types based on different capabilities, and we can choose which best suits our requirements.

接下来要做的决策是实例类型。AWS 基于不同能力提供种类繁多的实例类型，我们可以选择最符合需求的那种。

Instance Type

Hardware requirements can vary from customer to customer, so with this in mind, the EC2 service provides different instance types. Instance types define the hardware and performance characteristics of an EC2 instance. We might not always have a concrete answer for which instance type is most suitable. We can start by installing our application on any general-purpose instance and then perform load testing. This will help determine the limits where this specific instance breaks and can eventually help us figure out the instance type and the number of instances needed for the workload.

不同客户的硬件需求各不相同，因此 EC2 服务提供了不同的实例类型。实例类型定义了 EC2 实例的硬件和性能特征。我们未必总能确切知道哪种实例类型最合适。可以先把应用装在任意通用型实例上，然后做负载测试。这有助于确定该实例在何处会达到极限，最终帮我们弄清该负载所需的实例类型和实例数量。

Different instance types offer varying combinations of CPU, memory, storage, and networking capacities. The following are the different instance type families available:

不同实例类型提供 CPU、内存、存储和网络容量的不同组合。可用的实例类型系列如下：

  • General-purpose instances. Suitable for most of the workloads in the industry. They maintain a fine balance between compute, memory, and network resources.
    通用型实例。适用于业界大多数负载。它们在计算、内存和网络资源之间保持良好平衡。
  • Compute-optimized instances. Suitable for CPU-intensive workloads, such as high-performance computing, big data analytics, and so on.
    计算优化型实例。适用于 CPU 密集型负载，例如高性能计算、大数据分析等。
  • Memory-optimized instances. Suitable for workloads with requirements for large dataset processing in RAM, such as in-memory caches.
    内存优化型实例。适用于需要在 RAM 中处理大型数据集的负载，例如内存缓存。
  • Storage-optimized instances. Suitable for workloads with requirements for high sequential read and write access to large datasets on local storage such as databases.
    存储优化型实例。适用于需要对本地存储上的大型数据集做高顺序读写访问的负载，例如数据库。
  • Accelerated-computing instances. GPU-based instances that are suitable for workloads with requirements for high-performance computing, computational finance, ML, and so on.
    加速计算型实例。基于 GPU 的实例，适用于需要高性能计算、计算金融、ML 等的负载。

Choosing the appropriate instance type is crucial for achieving optimal performance and cost-efficiency for specific workloads. For updated guidance on instance types and instance families, refer to the AWS page on EC2 instance types.

为特定负载选择合适的实例类型，对于达到最佳性能和成本效益至关重要。关于实例类型和实例系列的最新指南，请参阅 AWS 上 EC2 实例类型的文档页。

Page 304

Here are some additional considerations to be mindful of when you launch an EC2 instance:

启动 EC2 实例时，还有一些额外注意事项：

  • To establish a connection with an instance after it has launched, you should select a key pair to enable Secure Shell (SSH) access to the instance.
    实例启动后要与之建立连接，你应选择一个密钥对以启用对实例的安全 Shell（SSH）访问。
  • EC2 instances are launched at the AZ level within a specific region. EC2 allows you to modify default network configurations, such as the VPC instance it should be launched in, the subnet in the VPC, the security group, and so on. These configurations help determine how the connection to launched instances will be established.
    EC2 实例在特定区域内的 AZ 级别启动。EC2 允许你修改默认网络配置，例如应启动在哪个 VPC、VPC 中的哪个子网、安全组等。这些配置决定了如何与已启动实例建立连接。
  • You can choose to assign a public IP to an instance. Public IP assignment allows connections to an instance directly from the public internet, given that you’ve set the appropriate permissions via either security groups or NACLs.
    你可以选择给实例分配一个公有 IP。分配公有 IP 后，只要你已通过安全组或 NACL 设置了适当权限，就允许从公网直接连接到实例。

For running the application at scale, we need a good balance of vertical and horizontal scaling for a number of instances in the entire infrastructure. By looking at usage metrics, we can figure out the minimum number of instances that will be required throughout a longer period. For such scenarios, cost can be reduced by using reserved EC2 instance capacity to get up to a 72% discount compared to on-demand instance pricing based on the usage commitment (a one-year or three-year commitment). Note that on-demand instances are instances that we launch as needed from the AWS Console, while we precommit to using EC2 instances for a certain period of time in the case of reserved instances.

要规模化运行应用，我们需要在整个基础设施中，对一批实例在垂直扩展和水平扩展之间取得良好平衡。通过查看用量指标，我们可以算出较长一段时间内所需的最少实例数。对于这类场景，可以使用预留 EC2 实例容量来降低成本：根据使用承诺（一年或三年承诺），相比按需实例定价最高可享 72% 折扣。注意，按需实例是我们在 AWS 控制台上按需启动的实例，而预留实例则是我们预先承诺在一段时间内使用 EC2 实例。

There may be use cases where we’re not much worried about losing (terminating) an instance while the workload is running or the workload can be resumed later once instances are available in the EC2 pool. For such scenarios, we can leverage something called spot instances.

有些用例中，我们不太担心负载运行时丢失（终止）某个实例，或者负载可以在 EC2 池中有实例后稍后恢复。对于这类场景，我们可以利用一种叫做竞价实例（spot instance）的东西。

Spot instances are less expensive than on-demand instances. Let’s take an example: assume the us-east-1a AZ has a total capacity of 100 m4.large instances. Out of these 100, half are already in use by customers. Based on AWS historic analysis, 30 instances will be requested by customers shortly as dedicated capacity. In this EC2 pool of 100 instances, 20 instances are left that no one is benefiting from—neither AWS nor its customers. So these instances are made available as spot instances at a lower cost. Customers can request spot instances from this pool for usage. For scenarios like AWS customers requiring more than the 30 available instances, as predicted earlier, any of the spot instances can be turned off and assigned to the requesting customers.

竞价实例比按需实例便宜。举个例子：假设 us-east-1a 这个 AZ 总共有 100 个 m4.large 实例的容量。这 100 个中有一半已被客户使用。根据 AWS 的历史分析，短期内客户还会以专用容量形式请求 30 个实例。在这 100 个实例的 EC2 池中，还剩 20 个实例没人受益——AWS 和客户都没用上。于是这些实例以更低成本作为竞价实例提供。客户可以从这个池中请求竞价实例来使用。当客户需要的实例数超过此前预测的 30 个可用实例时，任何一个竞价实例都可以被关停并分配给提出请求的客户。

Traffic on applications running on top of EC2 instances can vary across the day, and we might not always require a fixed number of running EC2 instances. For example, the application requires 10 instances at noon but only 2 at midnight. AWS offers an autoscaling feature that automatically adds and removes instances for the application. Let’s dive into autoscaling next.

运行在 EC2 实例之上的应用，其流量在一天中会变化，我们未必总需要固定数量的运行中 EC2 实例。例如，应用在中午需要 10 个实例，而午夜只需 2 个。AWS 提供自动扩展功能，自动为应用增加和移除实例。下面我们深入自动扩展。

Page 305

Autoscaling

Autoscaling is an AWS feature that automatically adjusts the number of EC2 instances in the collection in response to changing workload demands. We can create a collection of EC2 instances based on any factor, such as AZ, instance type, and so on. These collections are called autoscaling groups (ASGs) when autoscaling is enabled on them. In these groups, we can specify the minimum and maximum number of instances and apply an autoscaling policy for automatically adding and removing the instances within this limit. This helps maintain application performance and availability by dynamically scaling the capacity up or down based on predefined scaling policies.

自动扩展是 AWS 的一项功能，它根据不断变化的负载需求，自动调整一组 EC2 实例的数量。我们可以按任意因素创建一组 EC2 实例，例如 AZ、实例类型等。当在这些集合上启用自动扩展时，它们就称为自动扩展组（ASG）。在这些组中，我们可以指定实例的最小和最大数量，并应用自动扩展策略，在该限制内自动增加和移除实例。这通过根据预定义扩展策略动态扩缩容量，帮助维持应用性能和可用性。

Autoscaling can be configured to scale based on metrics like CPU utilization, network traffic, or user-defined metrics. It ensures that the application scales seamlessly to handle increased traffic and reduces costs during periods of low demand. Apart from handling scale, autoscaling can ensure that a fixed number of instances are always running in a healthy state (instances are replaced in case of health-check failures).

自动扩展可配置为基于 CPU 利用率、网络流量或用户自定义指标等指标来扩展。它确保应用无缝扩展以应对增长的流量，并在低需求时期降低成本。除处理扩展外，自动扩展还能确保固定数量的实例始终处于健康运行状态（健康检查失败时替换实例）。

Here is how a new instance is added as a cumulative CPU utilization limit is breached for an ASG (see Figure 11-2):

下面是当某 ASG 的累计 CPU 利用率突破阈值时，如何添加新实例（见图 11-2）：

  • For ASG 1, the minimum number of instances configured is one and the maximum is four.
    对于 ASG 1，配置的最小实例数为 1，最大为 4。
  • Assume that the autoscaling policy states that a new instance is added to the group if maximum CPU utilization exceeds 75% for five continuous minutes.
    假设自动扩展策略规定：如果最大 CPU 利用率连续 5 分钟超过 75%，就向组中添加一个新实例。
  • As the limit is breached, autoscaling kicks in with the desired number of instances going from one to two, and a new EC2 instance is launched.
    当突破阈值时，自动扩展启动，期望实例数从 1 变为 2，并启动一个新的 EC2 实例。

Large applications in the AWS cloud might be running thousands of EC2 machines to serve customer traffic or internal system processing, and failures are bound to happen. The EC2 instances might go down due to unforeseen hardware failures, and we as customers should have proper mechanisms in place to overcome these failures. There are multiple ways to handle these issues:

AWS 云中的大型应用可能运行着数千台 EC2 机器来服务客户流量或内部系统处理，故障在所难免。EC2 实例可能因不可预见的硬件故障而宕机，我们作为客户应具备恰当机制来克服这些故障。处理这些问题有多种方式：

  • Autoscaling policies to always maintain the desired number of instances within a group
    用自动扩展策略始终维持组内期望的实例数
  • EC2 instances launched in multiple AZs to withstand AZ failure
    把 EC2 实例启动在多个 AZ 中，以承受 AZ 故障
  • EC2 automatic recovery to relaunch the instance in case of failure; the instance is relaunched with the same configurations, such as instance ID, metadata, attached EBS volumes, private IPs, and EIP addresses
    EC2 自动恢复，在故障时重新启动实例；实例以相同配置重启，例如实例 ID、元数据、挂载的 EBS 卷、私有 IP 和 EIP 地址
Page 306

Autoscaling is a great tool for scaling instances up and down, but there is a limit to how quickly the instances are launched to address spiky traffic workloads. Relying on autoscaling for spiky traffic might abruptly cut off application availability; we recommend prescaling of instances for such events (for example, a live cricket match or an NFL event) or setting scaling configurations to a lower number (for example, set instance addition at 60% CPU utilization instead of 80%). To reduce application launch and startup time on new instances, keep the application image size as small as possible and don’t include unwanted dependencies.

自动扩展是扩缩实例的好工具，但实例启动速度应对突发尖峰流量负载存在上限。靠自动扩展应对尖峰流量可能会突然中断应用可用性；我们建议为此类事件（例如板球直播或 NFL 赛事）预先扩展实例，或把扩展配置阈值调低（例如把添加实例的 CPU 利用率设为 60% 而不是 80%）。为减少新实例上应用的启动时间，应尽量缩小应用镜像大小，不要包含不需要的依赖。

Apart from configuring the minimum and maximum number of instances in a scaling activity, we can define a cooldown period (the default is 300 seconds). After a scaling activity (launch or termination of an instance), AWS waits for the defined cooldown period before initiating any further scaling activities, ensuring stability of the ASG.

除了在扩展活动中配置最小和最大实例数外，我们还可以定义冷却期（默认 300 秒）。在一次扩展活动（启动或终止实例）之后，AWS 会等待所定义的冷却期，再发起任何进一步的扩展活动，以确保 ASG 的稳定性。

EC2 is the oldest and most widely used service for running applications in the AWS cloud. EC2 provides control over maintaining the software stack and maximum visibility of hardware operations. However, it might not always be a requirement to know how application software is deployed, or you might want to avoid any operational maintenance of systems, such as OS patching. AWS offers serverless services where customers don’t need to worry about instance provisioning or capacity planning. Serverless, as the name suggests, abstracts out server details and allows us to directly run our workloads. AWS Lambda operates on a serverless model, supporting code execution with the required scale.

EC2 是 AWS 云中运行应用历史最久、使用最广的服务。EC2 让你掌控软件栈的维护，并对硬件操作有最大可见性。然而，未必总是需要知道应用软件是如何部署的，或者你可能希望避免系统的任何运维维护，例如操作系统补丁。AWS 提供无服务器服务，客户不必操心实例开通或容量规划。无服务器顾名思义，把服务器细节抽象掉，让我们直接运行负载。AWS Lambda 以无服务器模型运行，支持以所需规模执行代码。

Page 307

AWS Lambda

AWS Lambda is a fully managed, serverless compute service that lets users run code without the overhead of server maintenance. The only thing we need to run our applications on Lambda is code in our preferred language, referred to as Lambda function. Lambda supports multiple programming languages and enables rapid development and deployment of event-driven applications. The backend architecture of Lambda is provisioned per function runtime and executed on customer invocation events. Lambda automatically scales the underlying infrastructure to match the workload, providing high availability and reliability. Here are the main concepts relating to the Lambda service that you should understand:

AWS Lambda 是全托管的无服务器计算服务，让用户运行代码而无需服务器维护开销。要在 Lambda 上运行应用，我们唯一需要的就是用偏好语言写的代码，称为 Lambda 函数。Lambda 支持多种编程语言，能快速开发和部署事件驱动应用。Lambda 的后端架构按函数运行时开通，并在客户调用事件时执行。Lambda 自动扩展底层基础设施以匹配负载，提供高可用和可靠性。下面是你应理解的与 Lambda 服务相关的主要概念：

  • Function. An application’s codebase in your preferred programming language that is supported by Lambda. Function is invoked with the help of a trigger to execute specific logic.
    函数（Function）。用 Lambda 支持的、你偏好的编程语言编写的应用代码库。函数借助触发器被调用来执行特定逻辑。
  • Trigger. Any resource or configuration that is responsible for invoking Lambda function—for example, invocation via the AWS Console or via any AWS services, such as Amazon SQS, Amazon DynamoDB streams, Amazon Kinesis, and so on.
    触发器（Trigger）。负责调用 Lambda 函数的任何资源或配置——例如通过 AWS 控制台调用，或通过 Amazon SQS、Amazon DynamoDB Streams、Amazon Kinesis 等 AWS 服务调用。
  • Event. A custom JSON-formatted document or any other structure specific to an AWS service, such as SNS notification, which is used to pass information to Lambda function for processing.
    事件（Event）。自定义的 JSON 格式文档、或 AWS 服务特有的任何其他结构（例如 SNS 通知），用于把信息传给 Lambda 函数处理。

Lambda execution environment. Lambda backend infrastructure internally creates a secure, isolated runtime environment for function execution. This runtime environment is called the execution environment and is set up with the help of user inputs, such as function language runtime, available memory, and maximum execution time for function (the maximum supported configuration is 15 minutes). The Lambda execution shuts down as the execution time elapses. The execution environment is launched with a specific instruction set architecture, and Lambda offers two types of architectures to determine computer processor type:

Lambda 执行环境。Lambda 后端基础设施在内部为函数执行创建一个安全、隔离的运行时环境。这个运行时环境称为执行环境，它借助用户输入搭建，例如函数语言运行时、可用内存和函数最长执行时间（支持的最大配置为 15 分钟）。执行时间用尽时，Lambda 执行就关闭。执行环境以特定指令集架构启动，Lambda 提供两种架构来决定计算机处理器类型：

  • ARM64 with 64-bit ARM architecture for AWS Graviton2 processors
    ARM64，采用 64 位 ARM 架构，用于 AWS Graviton2 处理器
  • x86-64 with 64-bit x86 architecture for x86-based processors
    x86-64，采用 64 位 x86 架构，用于基于 x86 的处理器

We recommend using ARM64 architecture for cost and performance efficiency over x86.

出于成本和性能效率考虑，我们建议使用 ARM64 架构而非 x86。

Page 308
  • Deployment package. The Lambda function code can be deployed via a deployment package in two ways:
    部署包。Lambda 函数代码可以通过部署包以两种方式部署：
  • A .zip file with code and its dependencies stored in Amazon S3 with a maximum allowed size of 250 MB. Lambda provides the OS and runtime for function.
    一个 .zip 文件，包含代码及其依赖，存储在 Amazon S3 中，最大允许 250 MB。Lambda 为函数提供操作系统和运行时。
  • A container image stored in Amazon ECR with the code and its dependencies and a maximum allowed size of 10 GB. The image should be compatible with OCI and should include the OS and runtime.
    一个容器镜像，存储在 Amazon ECR 中，包含代码及其依赖，最大允许 10 GB。该镜像应兼容 OCI，并应包含操作系统和运行时。
  • Layers. Common code, such as utilities or libraries, can be zipped as layers instead of adding them to each Lambda function. Layers can be attached to Lambda for code sharing, reducing the overall Lambda function code bundle size and decreasing the startup time. Layers also support versioning to maintain multiple versions of code libraries and ensure backward compatibility.
    层（Layers）。公共代码（如工具函数或库）可以打包成层，而不必加到每个 Lambda 函数里。层可以附加到 Lambda 上以共享代码，从而减小 Lambda 函数整体代码包大小、缩短启动时间。层还支持版本控制，以维护代码库的多个版本并确保向后兼容。
  • Destination. Another AWS service configured to receive invocation records upon completion (success or failure) of asynchronous Lambda execution. AWS supports standard SQS queue, standard SNS topic, Lambda function, and EventBridge event bus as destinations.
    目的地（Destination）。另一个 AWS 服务，被配置为在异步 Lambda 执行完成（成功或失败）时接收调用记录。AWS 支持标准 SQS 队列、标准 SNS 主题、Lambda 函数和 EventBridge 事件总线作为目的地。
AWS often adds new language runtimes; check the Lambda documentation for updated guidance on supported language runtimes.
AWS 经常新增语言运行时；关于受支持语言运行时的最新指南，请查看 Lambda 文档。

The way Lambda function should be invoked for processing depends on your use case. Some options include an object addition to an S3 bucket or a weekly schedule via CloudWatch events, or you may choose a specific trigger for Lambda invocation. Lambda supports three types of invocation modes:

Lambda 函数应以何种方式被调用来处理，取决于你的用例。一些选择包括：向 S3 桶添加对象、或通过 CloudWatch 事件做每周定时调度，你也可以为 Lambda 调用选择特定触发器。Lambda 支持三种调用模式：

  • Synchronous invocation. Synchronous invocation can be achieved in multiple ways: via the Amazon API Gateway, an ALB, the AWS CLI, and so on. In this invocation mode, customers wait for a response until Lambda completes its execution. This is preferred for latency-sensitive workloads with a maximum of a 15-minute execution timeout. In case Lambda is triggered via any AWS service, the execution timeout could be less, such as 29 seconds for API Gateway.
    同步调用。同步调用可以通过多种方式实现：通过 Amazon API Gateway、ALB、AWS CLI 等。在这种调用模式下，客户等待响应，直到 Lambda 完成执行。它适合执行超时最多 15 分钟的延迟敏感负载。如果 Lambda 是通过某个 AWS 服务触发的，执行超时可能更短，例如 API Gateway 为 29 秒。
Page 309
  • Asynchronous invocation. Asynchronous invocation can be achieved via S3, SNS, CloudWatch events, and so on. In this invocation mode, the response is returned immediately, and the request is queued by Lambda for processing. It can also be configured to handle retries and direct invocation responses to a configured destination, unlike synchronous mode.
    异步调用。异步调用可以通过 S3、SNS、CloudWatch 事件等实现。在这种调用模式下，响应立即返回，请求由 Lambda 入队处理。与同步模式不同，它还可以配置为处理重试，并把调用响应导向已配置的目的地。
  • Polling invocation. This is the preferred mode for stream- or queue-based services, such as DynamoDB streams, Kinesis, SQS queues, or Kafka. In this invocation mode, Lambda polls the AWS service and synchronously invokes Lambda function for processing. The benefit is that AWS doesn’t charge customers for message polling; we pay only for Lambda function invocation. The retry mechanism is dependent on the data expiration in the AWS service, such as from one minute to 14 days for an SQS queue.
    轮询调用。这是流或队列类服务（如 DynamoDB Streams、Kinesis、SQS 队列或 Kafka）的首选模式。在这种调用模式下，Lambda 轮询 AWS 服务，并同步调用 Lambda 函数处理。好处是 AWS 不对消息轮询向客户收费；我们只为 Lambda 函数调用付费。重试机制取决于 AWS 服务中的数据过期时间，例如 SQS 队列从 1 分钟到 14 天。

We mentioned Lambda provision resources on invocation, which could result in more request processing time due to cold-start problems. Cold start refers to the time Lambda takes to provision resources and prepare an execution environment involving function code downloaded from S3 or ECR, creating an environment with memory and runtime configurations and executing any initialization code out of the main function code. After this complete setup, Lambda starts serving customer requests. The cold-start time could vary from 100 ms to one second and typically occurs for 1% of total invocations, as analyzed by AWS on production workloads.

我们提到 Lambda 在调用时才开通资源，这可能因冷启动问题而增加请求处理时间。冷启动指 Lambda 开通资源、准备执行环境所花的时间，包括从 S3 或 ECR 下载函数代码、创建带内存和运行时配置的环境、并执行主函数代码之外的任何初始化代码。完成这整套设置后，Lambda 才开始服务客户请求。冷启动时间可能从 100 毫秒到 1 秒不等，根据 AWS 对生产负载的分析，通常发生在总调用的 1% 上。

AWS recommends multiple ways to reduce cold-start problems:

AWS 推荐多种方式来缓解冷启动问题：

  • Warm start. The execution environment is not deleted as soon as the function completes its execution but rather is retained for some time so as to serve continuous requests invoking the same Lambda function. This skips the setup of execution time on each Lambda invocation, which is referred to as a warm start. The cold start is not in the customer’s hands, and Lambda can create an execution environment on a need basis. For example, Lambda creates a fresh execution environment for concurrent invocation to handle increasing traffic. We can use warm start to our advantage by intentionally invoking Lambda function with dummy input before it serves actual requests. This approach is only recommended for scheduled or low-traffic workloads, not for production environments operating at large scale.
    热启动。执行环境不会在函数执行完成后立即删除，而是保留一段时间，以便服务调用同一 Lambda 函数的连续请求。这跳过了每次 Lambda 调用时的执行环境搭建时间，称为热启动。冷启动不由客户掌控，Lambda 会按需创建执行环境。例如，Lambda 为并发调用创建全新执行环境以应对增长的流量。我们可以利用热启动：在 Lambda 服务真实请求之前，故意用虚拟输入调用它。这种方法只推荐用于定时或低流量负载，不推荐用于大规模生产环境。
  • Provisioned concurrency. Provisioned concurrency ensures that the execution environment is set up in advance, ready to serve requests. For example, Lambda function with a provisioned concurrency of four will create four execution environments in parallel, which can be extremely helpful for functions with a large initialization codebase.
    预置并发。预置并发确保执行环境提前搭建好、随时可服务请求。例如，预置并发为 4 的 Lambda 函数会并行创建 4 个执行环境，这对初始化代码库很大的函数非常有帮助。
Page 310
  • Memory configurations. AWS provides an option to configure memory for Lambda function that ranges from 128 MB to 10,240 MB. The compute power allocated to Lambda function is proportional to the configured memory, so it is advisable to tune memory settings to improve performance. You can come up with the best memory configuration for your workload by running test runs on Lambda function, or you can explore using the Lambda Power Tuning tool for this purpose.
    内存配置。AWS 提供为 Lambda 函数配置内存的选项，范围从 128 MB 到 10,240 MB。分配给 Lambda 函数的计算能力与所配置内存成正比，因此建议调优内存设置以提升性能。你可以通过在 Lambda 函数上做测试运行来找到负载的最佳内存配置，也可以为此使用 Lambda Power Tuning 工具。
  • Static initialization optimization. As Lambda prepares the execution environment, it configures any required connections or downloads code dependencies. A large number of dependencies can definitely add to the cold-start time, so it is recommended to import only required dependencies. If the function codebase becomes too large where such a scenario is not feasible, other avenues can be explored, such as breaking a function into multiple child functions.
    静态初始化优化。Lambda 在准备执行环境时，会配置所需连接或下载代码依赖。大量依赖无疑会增加冷启动时间，因此建议只导入所需依赖。如果函数代码库太大、无法做到这一点，可以探索其他途径，例如把一个函数拆成多个子函数。
  • SnapStart. For Java 11 runtime environments, SnapStart improves function startup time by taking an encrypted snapshot of the memory and disk state of the initialized execution environment. The new function invocation resumes its execution from the cached snapshot, thereby improving on the cold-start time.
    SnapStart。对于 Java 11 运行时环境，SnapStart 通过对已初始化执行环境的内存和磁盘状态做加密快照，来改善函数启动时间。新的函数调用从缓存的快照恢复执行，从而缩短冷启动时间。

As mentioned, Lambda supports a variety of invocation modes and scales automatically for required traffic. The key factor when deciding whether to choose Lambda as a compute platform is determining whether you’re fine with too much abstraction of infrastructure. Consider: is there a requirement to fine-tune system efficiency at the infrastructure level? Is it OK if there is a latency spike due to cold-start issues? These are some of the questions you should try to answer to make your decision.

如前所述，Lambda 支持多种调用模式，并按所需流量自动扩展。决定是否选择 Lambda 作为计算平台时，关键因素是判断你是否接受基础设施被过度抽象。请考虑：是否需要在基础设施层面精细调优系统效率？因冷启动问题出现延迟尖峰是否可接受？这些是你做决策时应尝试回答的问题。

We discussed different containerization concepts in Chapter 7. Next, we’ll explore how we can use containers as a compute platform and launch our systems on the AWS cloud.

我们在第 7 章讨论了不同的容器化概念。下面探讨如何把容器用作计算平台，并在 AWS 云上启动我们的系统。

Containerization Services

AWS offers container orchestration for running Docker containers via two services: Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS). ECS is a fully managed container orchestration service, whereas EKS is a managed service for running open source Kubernetes on the AWS cloud.

AWS 通过两项服务提供容器编排来运行 Docker 容器：Amazon Elastic Container Service（ECS）和 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（EKS）。ECS 是全托管容器编排服务，而 EKS 是在 AWS 云上运行开源 Kubernetes 的托管服务。

This section builds on concepts covered in Chapter 7—read that chapter first.
本节建立在第 7 章所讲概念之上——请先阅读那一章。
Page 311

Amazon Elastic Container Service

Amazon ECS is a fully managed, highly available service for managing deployment, operations, and scaling of containerized applications for the required traffic load. ECS integrates with other AWS services, such as Amazon EC2, Amazon ECR, and AWS ELB, to provide a complete container management solution. The following is some important terminology related to Amazon ECS:

Amazon ECS 是全托管、高可用的服务，用于按所需流量负载管理容器化应用的部署、运维和扩展。ECS 与 Amazon EC2、Amazon ECR、AWS ELB 等其他 AWS 服务集成，提供完整的容器管理方案。下面是与 Amazon ECS 相关的一些重要术语：

  • Task. A task is the basic unit of deployment in ECS responsible for running one or more containers, as shown in Figure 11-3.
    任务（Task）。任务是 ECS 中的基本部署单元，负责运行一个或多个容器，如图 11-3 所示。
  • ECS service. The ECS service groups identical tasks to scale and monitors them in a single place.
    ECS 服务。ECS 服务把相同的任务分组以便扩展，并在一处监控它们。
  • ECS cluster. The infrastructure is registered to an ECS cluster, which acts as a logical grouping of ECS tasks or services running via ECS Fargate, ECS EC2 launch types, or both types in the single cluster.
    ECS 集群。基础设施注册到一个 ECS 集群，该集群作为 ECS 任务或服务的逻辑分组，这些任务/服务在同一集群中通过 ECS Fargate、ECS EC2 启动类型、或两种类型共同运行。
  • Task definitions. These define various configurations for a task, such as runtime platform, task size, launch type, data volumes, environment variables, container definitions for configurations specific to containers launched within a task, and so on. Task definitions enable you to define complex multicontainer applications and specify how they should be orchestrated.
    任务定义。它们定义任务的各种配置，例如运行时平台、任务大小、启动类型、数据卷、环境变量、任务内所启动容器的特定容器定义等。任务定义让你能定义复杂的多容器应用，并指定应如何编排它们。
Page 312

Here is an example with Fargate as the launch option:

下面是一个以 Fargate 作为启动选项的例子：

{
   "family": "fargate-task-definition",
   "containerDefinitions": [
      {
         "image": "AwsAccId.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/repository:tag",
         "name": "my-fargate-application",
         "portMappings": [
            {
               "containerPort": 80,
               "hostPort": 80,
            }
         ]
      }
   ],
   "essential": true,
   "cpu": "256",
   "memory": "512",
   "executionRoleArn": "arn:aws:iam::AwsAccId:role/ecsTaskExecutionRole",
   "networkMode": "awsvpc",
   "runtimePlatform": {
        "operatingSystemFamily": "LINUX"
    },
   "requiresCompatibilities": [
       "FARGATE"
    ]
}

Amazon Elastic Container Registry

Amazon ECR is an AWS-managed container image registry that can be used to push, pull, and manage Docker or OCI images.

Amazon ECR 是 AWS 托管的容器镜像仓库，可用于推送、拉取和管理 Docker 或 OCI 镜像。

Two types of launch options are available with ECS: (1) ECS EC2, where we manage our containers on a fleet of EC2 machines, and (2) ECS Fargate, a serverless option where we hand over complete operational management responsibility to AWS. The key differences between these two deployment options are listed in Table 11-1.

ECS 有两种启动选项：(1) ECS EC2，我们在一队 EC2 机器上管理容器；(2) ECS Fargate，一种无服务器选项，我们把完整的运维管理责任交给 AWS。这两种部署选项的关键区别列于表 11-1。

Comparison factorAmazon ECS EC2Amazon ECS Fargate
Operational managementThe compute layer is managed by customers, such as instance type and number of EC2 instances, application scaling, OS-level patching, and so on. EC2 supports autoscaling to adjust the number of instances based on resource utilization or application demand.Serverless, meaning customers don’t have to worry about server management tasks, such as applying OS security patches. Customers can specify OS, vCPU, memory, and autoscaling configurations.
表 11-1。Amazon ECS 启动类型。运维管理：ECS EC2 的计算层由客户管理，例如 EC2 实例类型和数量、应用扩展、操作系统级补丁等；EC2 支持自动扩展，根据资源利用率或应用需求调整实例数。ECS Fargate 是无服务器的，客户不必操心服务器管理任务（如打 OS 安全补丁）；客户可以指定操作系统、vCPU、内存和自动扩展配置。
Page 313
Comparison factorAmazon ECS EC2Amazon ECS Fargate
PricingThere is no separate cost for ECS; customers are charged for the running time of EC2 instances plus any storage selection, such as EBS volumes.Cost is based on vCPU, memory, CPU architecture, and storage selection for ECS tasks or EKS pods, and customers are charged only when container workloads are active.
Business use casesAWS recommends ECS EC2 for workloads with high CPU or memory requirements, cost-optimization requirements, application requirements for persistent storage access, or compliance and organization requirements to manage infrastructure on your own.AWS recommends ECS Fargate for large workloads to be optimized for low overheads, small workloads with occasional bursts, and batch workloads.
LimitationsThere is extra operational overhead at the customer’s end for selecting EC2 instances, maintaining fleets, patching the OS, and so on.There is no support for graphics processing unit (GPU) and EBS volumes for persistent storage. You can use EFS volumes for persistent storage and bind mounts for ephemeral storage. In short, fewer customizations are available compared to ECS EC2.
表 11-1（续）。定价：ECS EC2 不单独收 ECS 费用；客户按 EC2 实例运行时间加所选存储（如 EBS 卷）付费。ECS Fargate 按 ECS 任务或 EKS pod 的 vCPU、内存、CPU 架构和所选存储计费，仅在容器负载活跃时收费。业务用例：AWS 推荐把 ECS EC2 用于高 CPU 或内存需求、成本优化需求、需要持久存储访问、或合规与组织要求自行管理基础设施的负载；推荐把 ECS Fargate 用于要优化低开销的大型负载、偶发突发的小型负载和批处理负载。局限：ECS EC2 在客户侧有选择实例、维护机群、打 OS 补丁等额外运维开销。ECS Fargate 不支持 GPU 和用于持久存储的 EBS 卷；可用 EFS 卷做持久存储、绑定挂载做临时存储；简言之，相比 ECS EC2 可定制项更少。

ECS seamlessly integrates with other AWS services, such as Amazon CloudWatch for observability, AWS IAM for security and access control, AWS Cloud Map, and AWS ALB to provide service discovery and load balancing capabilities. Cloud Map allows users to register and discover services dynamically, making it easier for containers to communicate with one another. ALB provides load balancing across containers, distributing traffic based on configured rules, which helps achieve high availability and scalability.

ECS 与其他 AWS 服务无缝集成，例如用于可观测性的 Amazon CloudWatch、用于安全与访问控制的 AWS IAM、AWS Cloud Map，以及提供服务发现和负载均衡能力的 AWS ALB。Cloud Map 让用户动态注册和发现服务，使容器之间更容易通信。ALB 在容器之间提供负载均衡，按配置规则分发流量，有助于实现高可用和可扩展。

Here are some additional key benefits of ECS:

下面是 ECS 的一些额外关键好处：

  • Scalability. ECS allows you to scale your containerized applications seamlessly based on demand. It automatically adjusts resources to handle traffic spikes efficiently via autoscaling or serverless compute options.
    可扩展性。ECS 让你根据需求无缝扩展容器化应用。它通过自动扩展或无服务器计算选项自动调整资源，高效应对流量尖峰。
  • High availability. ECS ensures high availability of your containers by spreading them across multiple AZs within a region. It automatically recovers failed containers and keeps your applications running smoothly.
    高可用。ECS 通过把容器分散到一个区域内的多个 AZ 来确保容器高可用。它自动恢复故障容器，让应用平稳运行。
  • Cost-effectiveness. With ECS, you pay only for the resources you use. It optimizes resource allocation and scales based on actual demand, helping to reduce costs.
    成本效益。使用 ECS，你只为所用资源付费。它优化资源分配并按实际需求扩展，帮助降低成本。
  • Security and compliance. ECS integrates with AWS IAM, allowing you to control access to your containers and resources. It also provides encryption options for data in transit and at rest.
    安全与合规。ECS 与 AWS IAM 集成，让你控制对容器和资源的访问。它还提供传输中和静态数据的加密选项。
Page 314

Amazon EKS is another service that AWS offers for launching applications on containers. Let’s explore how it differs from Amazon ECS and in which use cases customers generally prefer to go with EKS instead of ECS.

Amazon EKS 是 AWS 提供的另一项在容器上启动应用的服务。下面探讨它与 Amazon ECS 的区别，以及客户在哪些用例中通常更愿意选 EKS 而非 ECS。

Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service

Amazon EKS is a fully managed Kubernetes service that simplifies deploying, managing, and scaling containerized applications using Kubernetes on the AWS cloud. EKS eliminates the need for manual setup and configuration of Kubernetes clusters, so developers can focus on their applications rather than the underlying infrastructure. EKS is available with EKS EC2 and Fargate launch types, similar to ECS. Now you might wonder: why are there two different containerized services, and how do I decide which is best for my use case? Some of the key benefits of EKS include:

Amazon EKS 是全托管 Kubernetes 服务，简化在 AWS 云上用 Kubernetes 部署、管理和扩展容器化应用。EKS 免去了手动搭建和配置 Kubernetes 集群的需要，让开发者专注于应用而非底层基础设施。与 ECS 类似，EKS 也有 EKS EC2 和 Fargate 启动类型。现在你可能会问：为什么有两种不同的容器服务？我如何决定哪种最适合我的用例？EKS 的一些关键好处包括：

  • Managed Kubernetes control plane. EKS manages the Kubernetes cluster control plane, which includes the API server and etcd persistence database. This eliminates the administrative overhead of managing and scaling the control plane for the customer, ensuring high availability and a reliability guarantee from AWS.
    托管 Kubernetes 控制平面。EKS 管理 Kubernetes 集群控制平面，包括 API 服务器和 etcd 持久化数据库。这免除了客户管理和扩展控制平面的行政开销，并由 AWS 保证高可用和可靠性。
  • Multi-AZ support. EKS supports running Kubernetes clusters across multiple AZs, providing enhanced availability and fault tolerance. With cluster resources distributed across different AZs, applications running on EKS can tolerate failures and continue to operate seamlessly. The EKS control plane runs in three AZs with support for automatic detection and replacement of unhealthy nodes.
    多 AZ 支持。EKS 支持跨多个 AZ 运行 Kubernetes 集群，提供增强的可用性和容错。集群资源分布在不同 AZ，运行在 EKS 上的应用能容忍故障并继续无缝运行。EKS 控制平面运行在三个 AZ，并支持自动检测和替换不健康节点。
  • Automated Kubernetes version upgrades. EKS automatically handles Kubernetes version upgrades for the control plane, simplifying the process of staying up to date with the latest features and security patches. This helps ensure that clusters are running on stable, secure Kubernetes versions without requiring manual intervention.
    自动 Kubernetes 版本升级。EKS 自动处理控制平面的 Kubernetes 版本升级，简化了跟进最新特性和安全补丁的过程。这有助于确保集群运行在稳定、安全的 Kubernetes 版本上，而无需人工干预。
Page 315
  • Hybrid deployments. For highly latency-sensitive workloads, EKS on AWS Outposts can be used to operate applications at on-premises data centers. Outposts extends AWS infrastructure, services, and tools to the customer’s personal data center, essentially making it feasible to run EKS workloads there.
    混合部署。对于延迟极敏感的负载，可以用 AWS Outposts 上的 EKS 在本地数据中心运行应用。Outposts 把 AWS 基础设施、服务和工具延伸到客户的个人数据中心，从而使其在那里运行 EKS 负载成为可能。
  • Integration with AWS services. EKS seamlessly integrates with various AWS services, enabling developers to leverage the extensive ecosystem of AWS resources and capabilities. It integrates with services like AWS ELB, Amazon VPC, AWS IAM, AWS CloudTrail, and more, providing a unified experience for managing and securing applications.
    与 AWS 服务集成。EKS 与各种 AWS 服务无缝集成，让开发者利用 AWS 资源和能力的广阔生态。它与 AWS ELB、Amazon VPC、AWS IAM、AWS CloudTrail 等服务集成，为管理和保护应用提供统一体验。
  • Scalability and elasticity. With Amazon EKS, scaling Kubernetes clusters to accommodate increased workloads is effortless. It leverages Amazon EC2 instances and ASGs to dynamically scale worker nodes based on demand, or Fargate launch can be used as a serverless option. This allows applications to handle traffic spikes and change resource requirements seamlessly. We can also leverage EC2 spot instances to reduce the cost of EKS clusters or use GPU-optimized instances for high-performance computing.
    可扩展性与弹性。使用 Amazon EKS，扩展 Kubernetes 集群以容纳增长负载毫不费力。它利用 Amazon EC2 实例和 ASG 按需求动态扩展工作节点，或使用 Fargate 启动作为无服务器选项。这让应用无缝应对流量尖峰和资源需求变化。我们还可以利用 EC2 竞价实例降低 EKS 集群成本，或使用 GPU 优化实例做高性能计算。
  • Security and compliance. EKS incorporates several security features to protect applications and data. It integrates with AWS IAM to control access to cluster resources, supports fine-grained network policies using Amazon VPC, and allows encryption of data at rest using AWS KMS. EKS is compliant with various industry regulations, such as SOC, PCI DSS, ISO, FedRAMP Moderate, IRAP, C5, K-ISMS, ENS High, OSPAR, HITRUST CSF, and HIPAA.
    安全与合规。EKS 整合多项安全特性来保护应用和数据。它与 AWS IAM 集成以控制对集群资源的访问，支持用 Amazon VPC 做细粒度网络策略，并允许用 AWS KMS 加密静态数据。EKS 符合多项行业法规，如 SOC、PCI DSS、ISO、FedRAMP Moderate、IRAP、C5、K-ISMS、ENS High、OSPAR、HITRUST CSF 和 HIPAA。
  • Monitoring and logging. EKS provides integrations with popular monitoring and logging services, including Amazon CloudWatch and AWS CloudTrail. These services enable developers to gain insights into cluster performance, monitor resource utilization, and track API calls and events for auditing and troubleshooting purposes.
    监控与日志。EKS 与流行的监控和日志服务集成，包括 Amazon CloudWatch 和 AWS CloudTrail。这些服务让开发者洞察集群性能、监控资源利用率，并跟踪 API 调用和事件以做审计和故障排查。
  • Ecosystem and community. As an open source platform, Kubernetes has a vibrant ecosystem and community. EKS benefits from this by providing compatibility with Kubernetes-native tools, frameworks, and operators. Developers can leverage these tools to enhance their application’s deployment, management, and observability within the EKS environment.
    生态与社区。作为开源平台，Kubernetes 拥有活跃的生态和社区。EKS 通过兼容 Kubernetes 原生工具、框架和 operator 而从中受益。开发者可以利用这些工具，在 EKS 环境中增强应用的部署、管理和可观测性。
Page 316

Your love for open source could be just another reason to choose EKS, where you have complete visibility into the ongoing development and the Kubernetes internal architecture. EKS on AWS offers the benefits of both worlds: open source support as well as offloading of management tasks to AWS, along with easier integration with other AWS services.

你对开源的热爱可能正是选择 EKS 的又一个理由——在 EKS 上，你对正在进行的开发和 Kubernetes 内部架构有完全可见性。AWS 上的 EKS 兼具两者之长：开源支持，同时把管理任务卸载给 AWS，并能更容易地与其他 AWS 服务集成。

Conclusion

Selecting a compute platform for launching applications could be a difficult choice, so you should clearly lay out all the application requirements or expectations to help you make a wise decision. There is a philosophy of a “two-way door” decision-making process at Amazon that states, “You can always revert your decision if things are not working out as expected.” Similarly, the compute platform can always be reiterated as the application scope or traffic pattern changes for your application. Here are a few recommendations we think will be helpful in deciding on your compute platform:

为启动应用选择计算平台可能是个艰难的抉择，因此你应清楚列出所有应用需求或期望，以帮助自己做出明智决策。Amazon 有一种“双向门”决策哲学：“如果事情不如预期，你随时可以推翻自己的决定。”同样，随着应用范围或流量模式变化，计算平台也总是可以重新选择。下面是我们认为有助于你决定计算平台的几条建议：

  • Flexibility. EC2 offers maximum flexibility to users with customizations at the hardware level in addition to how software applications are deployed. In contrast, AWS Lambda abstracts the resources completely, and customers have to focus only on the code, with restrictions such as a maximum 15-minute invocation time. The higher flexibility of EC2 brings a larger operational overhead for system maintenance, such as OS patching for security issues, figuring out the most efficient instance type for the application, configuring autoscaling policies, deploying applications, and so on.
    灵活性。EC2 除了让你决定软件应用如何部署外，还在硬件层面提供最大灵活性。相比之下，AWS Lambda 把资源完全抽象掉，客户只需专注于代码，但有诸如最长 15 分钟调用时间之类的限制。EC2 更高的灵活性带来更大的系统运维开销，例如为安全问题打 OS 补丁、为应用确定最高效的实例类型、配置自动扩展策略、部署应用等。
  • Learning curve. As we start building and launching applications, familiarity with the platform is another factor to consider. More familiarity means fewer unknowns and quicker application launches. For example, if you’re completely new to any compute platform, it’s very easy to start with Lambda and launch applications in the minimum time possible since you just have to focus on writing code and skip all the headaches of application deployment and maintenance for the required traffic.
    学习曲线。当我们开始构建和启动应用时，对平台的熟悉程度是另一个要考虑的因素。越熟悉意味着未知越少、应用启动越快。例如，如果你对任何计算平台都完全陌生，从 Lambda 上手非常容易，能在最短时间内启动应用，因为你只需专注写代码，而不必为所需流量操心应用部署和维护的一切麻烦。
  • Traffic patterns. All compute platforms offered by AWS can operate at high scale. You should understand the requirements in hand and why a specific platform will best serve the business use case and provide cost efficiency. For example, EC2 or ECS EC2 provides more hardware control so could be a better choice for high-latency, sensitive operations or GPU-accelerated computing.
    流量模式。AWS 提供的所有计算平台都能大规模运行。你应理解手头的需求，以及为什么某个特定平台最能服务业务用例并提供成本效益。例如，EC2 或 ECS EC2 提供更多硬件控制，因此对于延迟敏感操作或 GPU 加速计算可能是更好的选择。
Page 317
  • Cost. It’s important to consider the cost of resources in the AWS cloud. The pricing model for each of the compute platforms varies, and there is no direct head-to-head comparison. Cost could depend on traffic patterns, size of workload, or resource selection, such as EC2 instance type, ECS Fargate task size, or Lambda memory configuration. Consider operational overhead as well because eventually people will maintain the operations.
    成本。考虑 AWS 云中资源的成本很重要。各计算平台的定价模型各不相同，没有直接的横向对比。成本可能取决于流量模式、负载大小或资源选择，例如 EC2 实例类型、ECS Fargate 任务大小或 Lambda 内存配置。也要考虑运维开销，因为最终是人来维护运营。

While you may not know the best solution right off the bat, don’t forget that it’s always a two-way-door decision and can be reiterated.

虽然你可能无法立刻知道最佳方案，但请记住：这始终是一个双向门决策，可以重新选择。
